claims: Italy faces Venezuela in the 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal between Italy and Venezuela is on Monday, March 16, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal between Italy and Venezuela is at LoanDepot park in Miami, Florida.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal between Italy and Venezuela is broadcast on FS1.
The winner of the Italy-Venezuela semifinal advances to the championship game on Tuesday.
Undefeated Italy reached its first semifinal by upsetting Puerto Rico.
Venezuela earned its semifinal spot by stunning defending champion Japan.
Italy is led by manager Francisco Cervelli.
The Italian team is on a 5-0 run.
Venezuela defeated Japan 8-5 in the quarterfinals.
Venezuela is making its first semifinal appearance since 2009.
Guardians infielder Brayan Rocchio is Venezuelan-born.
Brayan Rocchio is joining Team Italy for this match.
The winner of the semifinal will face Team USA or the Dominican Republic in the championship game.
